ms.report:
API documentation for each endpoint can be found in our dev backend: https://dev.gerowallet.io/swagger-ui/index.html#/
The endpoints related to the bank API are under the Kaiserex Controller, these also include error handling for various HTTP codes.
Here are the endpoints available right now:
・Get Card PIN Code
・Get verification link for KYC process
・Get user information
・Get user verification
・Get user’s cards
・Get card transaction history
・Get card details
・Get card UUID
・Get card balance
・Get cardano deposit address
・Block and Unblock virtual card
・Upload user documents
・Order a new virtual card
・Change card PIN code

Bank API Security Documentation can be found here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MqCgKKBKA--jIXCb8cnb95lrxvU0XaS0NV1ZgS05yxY/edit?usp=sharing
The doc includes details about:
・OAuth 2.0 PKCE authentication for KaiserEx (code verifier/challenge) and a token schema (access/refresh + expires_in).
・Token lifecycle management: storage in Chrome Storage + Vue (in-memory), auto-refresh on 401/near-expiry, validation/cleanup, and forced logout on failure.
・Security & encryption: AES (CryptoTS) with password-derived keys; HTTPS/TLS 1.3; bearer tokens; request/response interceptors; logout on auth errors.
・Data protection tiers:
・ L1 private keys/mnemonics (AES-encrypted),
・ L2 tokens/user info (secure persistence),
・ L3 card numbers (never stored),
・ L4 history/balances (encrypted in transit).
・State management: card store structure (auth/status/loading flags) and walletStatus flow (loading → auth/new/pending/approved/error) driving UI.
・Error handling: automatic token refresh, exponential backoff for network issues, and re-authentication on authentication failures.

Video demonstration: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0xXCvW_P9pE
The video demonstrates the following flow:
・User can register from within the wallet
・User can sign in within the wallet
・User can complete KYC within wallet (Which automatically creates a card order at the end of that flow)
